reviews.t: Everyone should own one because its amazing
reviews.x: Guysss, i can't tell u how excited I am. This is my first magnetic eyelashes. Heard s many good things about it and finally own one. Love the length and the layers of the lashes. I cant emphasized enough how easy this is to applied on. It comes with the magnetic eyeliner which helps the lashes to stay on just like glues. Its such a time saver and life saving. U should try and I guarantee u would love them.
Amazing product and easy to use! Will refer to friends and family
They're super easy to use. You just have to know how to do too eyeliner basically (I'm working on that myself don't feel bad 😂)

reviews.t: Eyelashes were awesome. Perfect size and they stay on perfectly!
reviews.x: I love the sizes of the eyelashes and they stay on well.

reviews.t: The idea behind these are great! Buuuuuut....

reviews.t: Just buy them you won't be disappointed
reviews.x: LOVE THEM SO MUCH!  Easy to use. Good for a first timer for Eyelashes!

Pulling the stick out of the tube, it felt like the liquid had dried. And then applying it, the liner went onto my lashes more than my actual eyelid. After I did the two layers of the liner, finally, I let it dry and put the lashes on. The issue was the lashes are too big for my eyes and I'm not exactly sure how I should trim it to fit. I was REALLY impressed at how easy they are to use; however, ALL of the pairs are TOTALLY uneven. The lengths and the volumes don't match their specific pairs. I can't return them in this time, so I am frustrated. Each pair should match or come close to matching. These are not the kind to buy if you don't want to look lopsided.

reviews.t: butterfly eyelashes and flyaway flakey liner.
reviews.x: The lashes applied easily but the liner flakes off after a few hours and the lashes were wayyyy too long.

reviews.t: Not a bad purchase for the cost, lasts all day.
reviews.x: So the lashes are a bit long, and the magnetic strip is as well. Trimming them is very touchy! The liner is a little sticky/tacky and takes a good minute and half to dry but once the lashes are on, They are on! They look pretty good for the money! Im very used to getting extensions professionally done, but currently I cannot due to our lovely pandemic. These worked for me to feel like my makeup is complete! I would recommend. reviews.t: Waste of money.. will not stay on..
reviews.x: These are cute but don't stay on. I have had magnetic eyelashes from other brands that were much different and secure. The eyeliner wasn't good and the applicator was wasn't shaped fine. I used some other magnetic eyeliner and these lashes still would not stay on. They had about 5 magnetic clips and were purposeless still. I have had magnetic lashes with three strips and had better results.

For the price it would have been great ,but tp be honest the liner  was sticky and bled even after an hour of application.  Only two pairs of the lashes were a matched pair.  I've purchased other lashes in the same $ value and if at least the lashes were good I would have been happier.  Sorry ..

I like the concept of this and I think it would work with some better supplies but with this one the lashes were huge in the eyeliner you had to put on multiple layers and every time you took off the eyelashes it would pick up the eyeliner so you couldn't replace them right after.

My wife love the magnetic eyelashes there are very easy to put on and she like that her eyelashes look fuller and more beautiful without having to put makeup on  There come in 5 different pairs so you can change up your eyelashes length and still look beautiful

The eyelashes have magnets haphazardly applied  on the band but the worst part was the magnetic eye liner was dried up and hard and I couldn't even attempt to use it period these eyelashes were a waste of money and also my time.

The liquid eyeliner is kinda messy when applied, it gets on my natural lashes, my natural lashes are fairly long, I wanted lashes so they could look fuller. Overall it’s ok, the lashes are nice, just the eyeliner is messy.

These were too long for my eyes. I Tried to trim between the magnets but they looked ridiculous. They aren't adjustable after put on either. It peels the magnetic eyeliner off and you have to reapply.
The lashes in the photo were beautiful! When I received them it looked like they were used. The first ones were kinda ripped and floppy. They look super cheap but the rest look nice.
The magnetic eyeliner was dry and didn’t come out at all. I bought this product because the price was so low, but you should spend a couple extra bucks and buy a different product.
I love these. They are easy to apply and remove. I got them bc of salons shut down. Probably won't go back as long as I can get these. These save me $$. No going back fo refills
For someone who is not use to wearing eyelashes this is the best. I loved them. I wear them on occasions. Easy to put on and they don't even feel like you have them on.
This product was a disappointment 😔 it was easy to use but the eyeliner was dry the eyelashes where hard and not a realistic fit like other brands I've purchased.
I only gave it 3 stars, because some of the magnets came off when I got them off my eyes. Otherwise I love the concept and these are super easy to use.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the lashes easy to apply and use, especially for first-timers.
The magnetic eyeliner is a common complaint, with reviewers reporting it dries out, flakes, smears, bleeds, or is sticky.
Several reviewers report the lashes stay on well and last all day.
Some reviewers complain about uneven or mismatched pairs and lashes that are too long.
Some reviewers report the lashes do not stay on securely.
